findings.title: Modified `config` variable is never used; original unmodified config is returned instead
findings.body: In `get_monitor_environment_context`, a copy of `monitor_environment.monitor.config` is made into `config` (line 160) and its `schedule_type` key is replaced with the human-readable display value (line 162). However, the returned dictionary on line 168 uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` (the original, unmodified dict) instead of the local `config` variable. This means the `schedule_type` display transformation is silently discarded and the raw enum value is sent in the event context. This is a pre-existing bug carried over from `mark_failed.py`, and this refactoring would be a good opportunity to fix it by changing line 168 to `"config": config`.
